PF1ME.Section.Title: Magic Equipment
PF1ME.Rename.Label: Rename
PF1ME.Rename.Hint: On Apply, rename the item to reflect its magic properties (e.g. "+2 Flaming Dagger") and set the unidentified name to the base item's name.
PF1ME.BaseItem.Label: Base Item
PF1ME.BaseItem.Missing: Base item could not be resolved. Re-link it, then Apply.
PF1ME.Enh.Label: Enhancement Bonus
PF1ME.Abilities.Label: Special Abilities
PF1ME.Material.Label: Special Material
PF1ME.Addon.Label: Material Add-on
PF1ME.Masterwork.Label: Masterwork
PF1ME.Warn.Incompatible: This ability may not be compatible with this weapon.
PF1ME.Settings.RageBuffNamesHint: Comma-separated buff names that count as 'raging' for abilities like Furious. Case-insensitive.
PF1ME.Settings.RageBuffFlagsHint: Comma-separated boolean item-flag names on a buff that count as 'raging'.
PF1ME.Settings.BaneCustomTypesHint: Comma-separated creature-type keys to offer as Bane targets in addition to the system's built-in types.
PF1ME.Settings.BaneHumanoidSubtypesHint: Comma-separated humanoid subtypes offered when Bane's designated foe is Humanoid.
PF1ME.Settings.BaneOutsiderSubtypesHint: Comma-separated outsider subtypes offered when Bane's designated foe is Outsider.
PF1ME.Settings.MasterworkMaterialsHint: Comma-separated materials that force masterwork, in addition to any the system already flags.
PF1ME.Settings.ShowHomebrewHint: Offer non-RAW abilities and materials in the pickers. Already-applied items keep working either way.
PF1ME.Shield.BashHint: Weapon abilities apply to this shield's bash; the AC enhancement bonus does not.
PF1ME.Aura.Label: Set aura
PF1ME.Aura.Hint: On Apply, recompute caster level and school.
